disclosure_boundary.reason: Potentially sensitive security evidence remains outside the public repository until the owner confirms rotation or coordinated disclosure.

observed: A populated OAuth client-secret field was observed in public careers-page configuration on more than one page.
No token request, credential validation, API call, account access, or data access was performed.
The exact affected routes and sensitive evidence are withheld from this public repository.
The menu, store locator, sign-in, rewards, and gift routes returned only a JavaScript-required terminal message to the non-JavaScript text client.
This confirms route behavior, not failure in every supported browser or assistive-technology configuration.
The public sitemap emits identical canonical product URLs under more than one category section.
Examples include product routes ending in /2122257/single and /2124652/single.
Earlier source inspection suggested repeated navigation and footer structures.
No accessibility-tree, focus-order, hidden-state, screen-reader, or supported-browser evidence is materialized in this packet.
The audit did not test whether the credential-like value is active.
The audit did not demonstrate token issuance, authorization, data access, or cross-account impact.
A JavaScript-required response alone does not establish a WCAG conformance failure.
A supported-browser and assistive-technology experiment is required before making that claim.
